disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 检查了所有源码中对 .credentials.yaml、~/.ssh、id_rsa 等敏感路径的引用。静态扫描命中集中在桌面应用的旧版凭据兼容模块（legacy-credential-compat.mjs：读取应用自有旧会话目录中的凭据文件，仅回填子进程环境缺失的引用，不写回不外发）、SSH 插件配置导入（从 ~/.ssh/config 导入主机配置）、维修模块（repair-model-availability.mjs 读取当前凭据文件用于模型可用性校验）、以及测试与文档。经分析全部为合法的本地配置管理用途，未发现窃取凭据后外发的代码路径。
checked_items.en: Checked all references to sensitive paths such as .credentials.yaml, ~/.ssh, id_rsa in all source code. Static scan hits are concentrated in the legacy credential compatibility module of the desktop application (legacy-credential-compat.mjs: reads credential files from the app's own legacy session directory, only backfills references missing in subprocess environment variables, does not write back or exfiltrate), SSH plugin configuration import (imports host configuration from ~/.ssh/config), the repair module (repair-model-availability.mjs reads current credential files for model availability validation), and tests and documentation. Analysis shows all are legitimate local configuration management purposes; no code path that exfiltrates credentials after theft was found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了凭据文件读取的安全限制。旧版凭据兼容模块对文件大小做了上限（1MB）、拒绝符号链接、校验引用名格式（仅允许大写字母数字下划线且不包含敏感前缀）——这些限制排除了大部分滥用路径。
checked_items.en: Checked security restrictions on credential file reading. The legacy credential compatibility module imposes a file size limit (1MB), rejects symlinks, and validates the reference name format (only uppercase alphanumeric characters and underscores allowed, without sensitive prefixes) — these restrictions rule out most abusive paths.

checked_items.zh: 机械命中逐条裁决（DSH-C01→DG-R1-51）：全部 .credentials.yaml / ~/.ssh / id_rsa 命中可归因于上述本地配置管理、桌面宿主功能、测试与文档，无一条构成凭据窃取或外发证据链，裁决为良性，不产出 finding。
checked_items.en: Mechanical hits adjudicated item by item (DSH-C01→DG-R1-51): all .credentials.yaml / ~/.ssh / id_rsa hits can be attributed to the above local configuration management, desktop host functionality, tests and documentation; none constitutes a chain of evidence for credential theft or exfiltration. Adjudicated as benign, no finding produced.

evidence.zh: 凭据外泄无网络闸：虽然 dsh 沙箱不约束网络（生态固有风险描述），但本仓库的代码中未发现凭据读取后经网络外发的证据链。旧版凭据兼容模块的读取结果仅回填子进程环境变量，无网络发送路径。SSH 配置导入仅读取本地文件用于插件配置。
evidence.en: Credential exfiltration without network barrier: although the dsh sandbox does not restrict network (ecosystem inherent risk description), no chain of evidence was found in this repository's code for credential exfiltration over the network after reading. The legacy credential compatibility module only backfills results into subprocess environment variables, with no network sending path. The SSH configuration import only reads local files for plugin configuration.

checked_items.zh: 检查了所有模型面指令文件（SKILL.md 2 个、AGENTS.md 约 10 个）。内容为仓库开发规则、发版流程、皮肤开发指南、文档标准等，属开发者协作文件，不含指令覆写、系统消息伪装、优先级操纵、远程指令加载等注入措辞（DSH-X10→DG-R2-57 裁决为良性）。
checked_items.en: Checked all model-facing instruction files (SKILL.md 2, AGENTS.md ~10). Content consists of repository development rules, release workflows, skin development guides, documentation standards, etc. These are developer collaboration files, containing no injection wording such as instruction override, system message disguise, priority manipulation, or remote instruction loading (DSH-X10→DG-R2-57 adjudicated as benign).

checked_items.zh: 检查了系统提示片段注册调用（4 处：dsh-aionui-panel、dsh-liangshen、dsh-ssh、dsh-task-board）。内容均为各自插件的功能说明用法，无恶意指令注入（DSH-T02→DG-R2-52 裁决为良性）。
checked_items.en: Checked system prompt fragment registration calls (4 locations: dsh-aionui-panel, dsh-liangshen, dsh-ssh, dsh-task-board). Content is the functional description and usage of each respective plugin, with no malicious instruction injection (DSH-T02→DG-R2-52 adjudicated as benign).

checked_items.zh: 检查了工具注册的描述文本。未发现凭证读取诱导、安装诱导、系统指令覆写或隐藏意图。
checked_items.en: Checked description texts of tool registrations. No credential theft inducement, installation inducement, system instruction override, or hidden intent was found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 pre-step 消息监听语义。dsh-liangshen 预设的引导过滤器（DSH-L03→DG-R2-58）在 agent/pre-step 事件中筛选消息种类——第一阶段仅保留显式用户消息、推迟部分注入类消息（如工作区指令、技能目录），是收缩模型输入面的守卫式过滤，不向消息注入指令，裁决为良性。
checked_items.en: Checked pre-step message listening semantics. The preset bootstrap filter of dsh-liangshen (DSH-L03→DG-R2-58) filters message types in the agent/pre-step event — in the first phase, only explicit user messages are retained, and certain injection-type messages (such as workspace directives, skill catalogs) are deferred. This is a guard-style filter that shrinks the model input surface, does not inject instructions into messages, and is adjudicated as benign.

checked_items.zh: 检查了附件存储扩展（DSH-L09→DG-R2-60）和隐藏指令模式。AttachmentStore 扩展仅出现在测试夹具中；HTML 注释/CSS 元数据中未发现藏匿指令。
checked_items.en: Checked attachment storage extension (DSH-L09→DG-R2-60) and hidden instruction patterns. The AttachmentStore extension appears only in test fixtures; no hidden instructions found in HTML comments/CSS metadata.

evidence.zh: 工具描述投毒：检查了所有工具注册的描述字段和系统提示片段，未发现包含系统指令、凭证读取诱导、越权指令或隐藏意图的描述。
evidence.en: Tool description poisoning: checked all tool registration description fields and system prompt fragments; no descriptions containing system instructions, credential theft inducement, privilege escalation instructions, or hidden intent were found.

evidence.zh: 提示注入驱动安装：检查了工具描述中是否包含诱导安装插件、改写配置、放开权限的措辞，未发现此类诱导文本。
evidence.en: Prompt injection driven installation: checked whether tool descriptions contain wording that induces plugin installation, configuration rewriting, or permission escalation; no such inductive text was found.

evidence.zh: Pre-step 消息改写：dsh-liangshen 预设注册了 agent/pre-step 监听器（packages/dsh-liangshen/presets/liangshen/tool-bootstrap.mjs:314），仅筛选消息种类（第一阶段仅允许 user 来源消息，推迟注入类消息），不向消息中注入指令，是合法的守卫式过滤，无恶意改写。
evidence.en: Pre-step message rewriting: dsh-liangshen preset registers an agent/pre-step listener (packages/dsh-liangshen/presets/liangshen/tool-bootstrap.mjs:314), which only filters message types (in the first phase, only user-origin messages are allowed; injection-type messages are deferred), does not inject instructions into messages. This is a legitimate guard-style filter, with no malicious rewriting.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部挂载补丁（cordis.patch.yml 文件）。所有补丁仅包含向插件清单插入行的操作，无 !!js 可执行标量。DSH-P01→DG-R3-51 的命中全部出现在 dsh-tool-describe-image 包的 README 和测试中（作为文档示例建议从环境注入密钥），非实际补丁文件，裁决为良性。
checked_items.en: Checked all mounted patches (cordis.patch.yml files). All patches only contain operations to insert lines into plugin manifests, with no !!js executable scalars. All hits of DSH-P01→DG-R3-51 appear in the README and tests of the dsh-tool-describe-image package (as documentation examples suggesting injecting secrets from environment), not actual patch files, adjudicated as benign.

checked_items.zh: 检查了安装钩子（preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare）。所有包的 prepare 脚本均为构建工具（tsdown、build.mjs、pnpm run build），无远程载荷下载执行（DSH-X02→DG-R3-54 裁决为良性）。
checked_items.en: Checked install hooks (preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare). The prepare scripts of all packages are build tools (tsdown, build.mjs, pnpm run build), with no remote payload download and execution (DSH-X02→DG-R3-54 adjudicated as benign).

checked_items.zh: 检查了子进程与危险函数调用。命中全部对应桌面宿主合法功能（Git 管理、终端模拟、pnpm 插件安装、更新流程、运行时启动子进程、测试运行器）以及插件功能（Git 图谱、远程 Web UI 更新、SSH 测试辅助）。未发现 eval/new Function 动态执行不可信输入的代码模式（DSH-X03→DG-R3-55 裁决为良性）。
checked_items.en: Checked subprocess and dangerous function calls. Hits all correspond to legitimate desktop host functionality (Git management, terminal emulation, pnpm plugin installation, update workflow, runtime subprocess spawning, test runner) and plugin functionality (Git graph, remote Web UI update, SSH test helper). No code pattern of dynamic execution of untrusted input via eval/new Function was found (DSH-X03→DG-R3-55 adjudicated as benign).

checked_items.zh: 检查了动态包工具调用（cordis_define/cordis_run）。未发现任何调用（DG-S03 不适用）。
checked_items.en: Checked dynamic package tool calls (cordis_define/cordis_run). No calls found (DG-S03 not applicable).

checked_items.zh: 检查了树内执行载体（工作流文件）。全部为标准 CI/CD 流程（lint、测试、构建、发布、部署），不在 dsh 宿主运行时执行面内（DSH-X07→DG-R3-59 裁决为良性）。
checked_items.en: Checked in-tree execution carriers (workflow files). All are standard CI/CD workflows (lint, test, build, publish, deploy), not within the dsh host runtime execution surface (DSH-X07→DG-R3-59 adjudicated as benign).

checked_items.zh: 检查了代码混淆信号（超长行、高熵数据、转义密度）。超长行与高熵命中全部为皮肤艺术图 base64 编码（鲸鱼、WebP 背景等）、CSS 字符串、source map，无混淆代码。转义密度命中为控制字符合法性校验正则表达式，无混淆意图（DSH-X08→DG-R3-60 裁决为良性）。
checked_items.en: Checked code obfuscation signals (excessively long lines, high-entropy data, escape density). All excessively long lines and high-entropy hits are skin art base64 encodings (whale, WebP background, etc.), CSS strings, and source maps, with no obfuscated code. The escape density hits are control character validation regular expressions, with no obfuscation intent (DSH-X08→DG-R3-60 adjudicated as benign).

checked_items.zh: 检查了客户端 bundle 的键盘监听与剪贴板调用。命中均为桌面 UI 交互（快捷键、Escape 关闭对话框、复制路径按钮），无键盘记录或剪贴板窃取意图，无凭证 RPC 调用（DSH-X05→DG-R3-57 裁决为良性；DG-S09 场景核查通过）。
checked_items.en: Checked keyboard listener and clipboard calls in client bundles. All hits are desktop UI interactions (keyboard shortcuts, Escape to close dialog boxes, copy path button), with no keylogging or clipboard theft intent, and no credential RPC calls (DSH-X05→DG-R3-57 adjudicated as benign; DG-S09 scenario check passed).

checked_items.zh: 检查了子代理委派（DSH-L04→DG-R3-62）和 dsh 原生持驻（DSH-L05→DG-R3-63）。生产代码无 registerProvider 调用，无 jobs.start/schedule_create 调用，不适用。
checked_items.en: Checked sub-agent delegation (DSH-L04→DG-R3-62) and dsh native persistence (DSH-L05→DG-R3-63). Production code has no registerProvider calls, no jobs.start/schedule_create calls, not applicable.

evidence.zh: Patch 即 RCE：检查了全部 yml/yaml 文件中的可执行 JS 标量。所有补丁文件均不包含 !!js/!!js/function/!!js/regexp 标量。11 处命中均出现在 dsh-tool-describe-image 的 README 和测试中（文档示例），非实际补丁文件。
evidence.en: Patch equals RCE: checked all yml/yaml files for executable JS scalars. All patch files contain no !!js/!!js/function/!!js/regexp scalars. 11 hits all appear in the README and tests of dsh-tool-describe-image (documentation examples), not actual patch files.

evidence.zh: Self-modification 滥用：检查了动态包工具调用（cordis_define/cordis_run），未发现任何调用。子进程调用均在桌面宿主合法场景（Git 管理、终端模拟、插件安装、更新流程）中。
evidence.en: Self-modification abuse: checked dynamic package tool calls (cordis_define/cordis_run), no calls found. Subprocess calls are all within legitimate desktop host scenarios (Git management, terminal emulation, plugin installation, update workflow).

evidence.zh: Git HEAD + prepare：所有包的 prepare 脚本均为构建工具（tsdown、build.mjs、pnpm run build），无远程安装执行。应用和插件依赖使用版本号或 workspace 协议，无浮动 git 引用。
evidence.en: Git HEAD + prepare: the prepare scripts of all packages are build tools (tsdown, build.mjs, pnpm run build), with no remote installation execution. Application and plugin dependencies use version numbers or workspace protocol, with no floating git references.

evidence.zh: Client.js 自动加载：静态扫描未检出 dsh.client 声明命中（DSH-X04 无命中）；客户端 bundle 中的键盘监听与剪贴板调用均为合法 UI 交互（快捷键、复制路径），无键盘记录、剪贴板窃取或凭证 RPC 调用。
evidence.en: Client.js auto-load: static scan did not detect any dsh.client declaration hits (DSH-X04 no hits); keyboard listener and clipboard calls in client bundles are all legitimate UI interactions (keyboard shortcuts, copy path), with no keylogging, clipboard theft, or credential RPC calls.

evidence.zh: 外部子代理委派：生产代码中未发现 registerProvider 调用（DSH-L04 无命中），不适用。
evidence.en: External sub-agent delegation: no registerProvider calls found in production code (DSH-L04 no hits), not applicable.

evidence.zh: DSH 原生持驻：未发现 jobs.start/schedule_create/create_goal 调用（DSH-L05 无命中）；任务看板插件的定时调度是浏览器端 setInterval 心跳（非 dsh 原生持驻 API），不适用。
evidence.en: DSH native persistence: no jobs.start/schedule_create/create_goal calls found (DSH-L05 no hits); the scheduled scheduling in the task board plugin is a browser-side setInterval heartbeat (not a dsh native persistence API), not applicable.

checked_items.zh: 检查了外联端点。桌面宿主的外联为声明的用户功能：npm 插件注册表（registry.npmjs.org）、社区插件目录（awesome-dsh-plugin.com）、GitHub 发布/反馈链接、内置 Git 下载、更新通道。未发现指向未声明端点的隐藏外联。
checked_items.en: Checked outbound endpoints. The outbound connections of the desktop host are declared user functions: npm plugin registry (registry.npmjs.org), community plugin directory (awesome-dsh-plugin.com), GitHub release/feedback links, built-in Git download, update channel. No hidden outbound connections to undeclared endpoints were found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了凭据读取与外联的组合行为。旧版凭据兼容模块读取本地凭据文件，结果仅回填到子进程环境变量，无网络发送路径。
checked_items.en: Checked the combination of credential reading and outbound connections. The legacy credential compatibility module reads local credential files, and the results are only backfilled into subprocess environment variables, with no network sending path.

checked_items.zh: 检查了命令行外发（DSH-C05→DG-R4-53）。命中仅出现在皮肤中心包的文档注释中（说明该工具也接受 curl 客户端），非运行时或安装脚本中实际使用 curl 外发数据。
checked_items.en: Checked command-line exfiltration (DSH-C05→DG-R4-53). Hits only appear in the documentation comments of the skin center package (explaining that the tool also accepts curl clients), not actual use of curl to exfiltrate data at runtime or in install scripts.

checked_items.zh: 检查了编码外发链与带外通道。未发现读取敏感文件→编码变换→网络发送三段齐备的证据链。
checked_items.en: Checked encoded exfiltration chains and out-of-band channels. No complete chain of evidence of reading sensitive files → encoding transformation → network sending was found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 LLM 路由劫持面（DSH-L01→DG-R4-54、DSH-L02→DG-R4-55、DSH-L06→DG-R4-56）。生产代码无 agent/request 监听器，无自定义模型适配器注册（DSH-L02 仅在 dsh-desktop-compat 的测试夹具中命中，裁决为良性），无 agent/request-error 监听器。DG-S13 不适用。
checked_items.en: Checked LLM route hijacking surface (DSH-L01→DG-R4-54, DSH-L02→DG-R4-55, DSH-L06→DG-R4-56). Production code has no agent/request listeners, no custom model adapter registrations (DSH-L02 hits only in test fixtures of dsh-desktop-compat, adjudicated as benign), no agent/request-error listeners. DG-S13 not applicable.

evidence.zh: 凭据外泄无网络闸：虽然 dsh 沙箱不约束网络（生态固有风险），但本仓库代码中未发现凭据读取后经网络外发的证据链。旧版凭据兼容模块读取本地凭据仅回填子进程环境，无网络发送。
evidence.en: Credential exfiltration without network barrier: although the dsh sandbox does not restrict network (ecosystem inherent risk), no chain of evidence was found in this repository's code for credential exfiltration over the network after reading. The legacy credential compatibility module only backfills local credentials into subprocess environment, with no network sending.

evidence.zh: LLM 路由运行时劫持：生产代码中无 agent/request 监听器，无 registerAdapter 调用（DSH-L02 仅命中测试夹具的 fixture provider，DSH-L01/DSH-L06 无命中），不适用。
evidence.en: LLM route runtime hijacking: production code has no agent/request listeners, no registerAdapter calls (DSH-L02 only hits test fixture's fixture provider, DSH-L01/DSH-L06 no hits), not applicable.

checked_items.zh: 检查了补丁覆盖安全行。所有补丁仅包含插入行，未禁用 sandbox/approval/permission，未用环境变量降权，未改写 inject/intercept 配置（DG-S05、DG-S11 均通过）。
checked_items.en: Checked patch override security lines. All patches only contain insertions, do not disable sandbox/approval/permission, do not downgrade privileges via environment variables, do not override inject/intercept configuration (DG-S05, DG-S11 both passed).

checked_items.zh: 检查了安全事件前置监听。未发现 prepend 监听工具预执行（tools/pre-execute）或审批请求（approval/request）事件并截断链条的代码（DG-S06 通过）。dsh-liangshen 的 prepend 监听作用于提示组装与 pre-step 消息面，不触及审批链。
checked_items.en: Checked security event prepend listeners. No code that prepends listeners on tool pre-execution (tools/pre-execute) or approval request (approval/request) events and intercepts the chain was found (DG-S06 passed). The prepend listeners of dsh-liangshen act on prompt assembly and pre-step message surfaces, not touching the approval chain.

checked_items.zh: 检查了升级能力声明突变。相对于基线版本 3.0.1@f718ac0，未观察到新增 dsh.bundle/dsh.client/dsh.service 声明的突变（DG-S07 通过）。
checked_items.en: Checked upgrade capability declaration mutations. Relative to the baseline version 3.0.1@f718ac0, no mutations in newly added dsh.bundle/dsh.client/dsh.service declarations were observed (DG-S07 passed).

checked_items.zh: 检查了依赖浮动引用。应用与插件依赖使用版本号或 workspace 协议，无未锁定 commit 的 git 依赖。桌面宿主的外部插件安装功能由用户显式授权并校验来源与完整性。
checked_items.en: Checked dependency floating references. Application and plugin dependencies use version numbers or workspace protocol, with no git dependencies on unlocked commits. The desktop host's external plugin installation functionality is explicitly authorized by the user and validated for source and integrity.

checked_items.zh: 检查了作者身份风险。仓库活跃、多贡献者，作者账号有开发历史。
checked_items.en: Checked author identity risk. The repository is active with multiple contributors; the author account has development history.

evidence.zh: Patch 覆盖安全行：检查了所有补丁文件，未发现禁用 sandbox/approval/permission 的行，也未发现用环境变量降权的写法。
evidence.en: Patch override security lines: checked all patch files, no lines disabling sandbox/approval/permission were found, and no pattern of downgrading privileges via environment variables was found.

evidence.zh: Waterfall 短路：检查了前置监听安全事件的模式，未发现前置监听工具预执行或审批请求事件且不调用放行函数的代码。
evidence.en: Waterfall short-circuit: checked the pattern of prepending security event listeners; no code that prepends listeners on tool pre-execution or approval request events without calling the pass-through function was found.

evidence.zh: 升级自动激活：相对基线报告（3.0.1@f718ac0），未观察到新增 dsh.bundle/dsh.client/dsh.service 声明突变导致自动激活的风险。
evidence.en: Upgrade automatic activation: relative to the baseline report (3.0.1@f718ac0), no risk of automatic activation due to newly added dsh.bundle/dsh.client/dsh.service declaration mutations was observed.

evidence.zh: Inject/intercept 篡改：检查了补丁文件是否改写注入/拦截配置使安全插件依赖不存在服务，未发现此类操作。
evidence.en: Inject/intercept tampering: checked whether patch files modify injection/interception configuration to make security plugin dependencies unavailable; no such operations were found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了插件包启动 web 服务或监听端口的行为。未发现插件包中自行启动 HTTP 服务器或监听端口的代码。皮肤中心包的 HTTP 路由走宿主 webserver 的插件路由面，非独立监听。桌面宿主本身的 webserver 无认证问题属生态固有风险，不归因于本仓库插件。
checked_items.en: Checked whether plugin packages start a web service or listen on a port. No code in plugin packages that starts an HTTP server or listens on a port was found. The HTTP routing of the skin center package goes through the host webserver's plugin routing surface, not independent listening. The desktop host's own webserver without authentication is an ecosystem inherent risk, not attributable to this repository's plugins.

checked_items.zh: 检查了动态沙盒验证结果。未提供动态沙盒产物（l4-sandbox.json 不存在），未做动态验证。
checked_items.en: Checked dynamic sandbox verification results. No dynamic sandbox artifact provided (l4-sandbox.json does not exist), no dynamic verification performed.

evidence.zh: 本机无认证 RPC：未发现插件包中启动 web 服务或监听端口的行为。dsh 宿主本身的 webserver 无认证问题属于生态固有风险，不归因于本仓库中的插件包。
evidence.en: Local unauthenticated RPC: no code in plugin packages that starts a web service or listens on a port was found. The dsh host's own webserver without authentication is an ecosystem inherent risk, not attributable to the plugin packages in this repository.

summary.zh: 元数据与身份校验通过。仓库为 dsh 生态桌面宿主与插件集合的 monorepo，package.json 依赖 @deepseek-ai/dsh 等 SDK。作者身份未核验（非官方）。
summary.en: Metadata and identity verification passed. The repository is a monorepo of dsh ecosystem desktop host and plugins; package.json depends on @deepseek-ai/dsh and other SDKs. Author identity not verified (not official).

summary.zh: 静态扫描 264 条机械命中按规则逐条裁决：DSH-P01→DG-R3-51（!!js）仅出现在文档示例中；DSH-X02→DG-R3-54（prepare 钩子）均为构建工具；DSH-X03→DG-R3-55（子进程/危险函数）为桌面宿主与插件合法功能；DSH-X05→DG-R3-57（键盘/剪贴板）为 UI 交互；DSH-X07→DG-R3-59（工作流）为 CI/CD 标准流程；DSH-X08→DG-R3-60（混淆信号）为皮肤图片资产/source map/控制字符校验正则；DSH-C01→DG-R1-51（凭据路径）为本地配置管理；DSH-C05→DG-R4-53（curl）仅文档注释；DSH-X10→DG-R2-57（指令文件）为开发者协作文件；DSH-T02→DG-R2-52（系统提示注册）为插件功能描述；DSH-L02→DG-R4-55（registerAdapter）仅测试夹具；DSH-L03→DG-R2-58（pre-step 监听）为守卫式消息过滤；DSH-L09→DG-R2-60（AttachmentStore）仅测试夹具。全部裁决为良性，未发现恶意代码执行模式。
summary.en: 264 mechanical static scan hits adjudicated per rule: DSH-P01→DG-R3-51 (!!js) only appears in documentation examples; DSH-X02→DG-R3-54 (prepare hooks) are all build tools; DSH-X03→DG-R3-55 (subprocess/dangerous functions) are legitimate desktop host and plugin functionality; DSH-X05→DG-R3-57 (keyboard/clipboard) are UI interactions; DSH-X07→DG-R3-59 (workflows) are standard CI/CD processes; DSH-X08→DG-R3-60 (obfuscation signals) are skin image assets/source map/control character validation regex; DSH-C01→DG-R1-51 (credential paths) are local configuration management; DSH-C05→DG-R4-53 (curl) only documentation comments; DSH-X10→DG-R2-57 (instruction files) are developer collaboration files; DSH-T02→DG-R2-52 (system prompt registration) are plugin function descriptions; DSH-L02→DG-R4-55 (registerAdapter) only test fixtures; DSH-L03→DG-R2-58 (pre-step listener) is guard-style message filtering; DSH-L09→DG-R2-60 (AttachmentStore) only test fixtures. All adjudicated as benign, no malicious code execution pattern found.

summary.zh: 行为分析未发现异常模式。无安装钩子远程执行、无解码即执行、无混淆载荷、无凭据文件外发组合。
summary.en: Behavioral analysis found no anomalous patterns. No install hook remote execution, no decode-and-execute, no obfuscated payloads, no credential file exfiltration combinations.

summary.zh: AI 元数据审查未发现工具描述投毒或指令注入。SKILL.md/AGENTS.md 为开发者协作文件，非注入到用户 LLM 会话的内容。系统提示片段注册为合法插件功能。pre-step 消息过滤器（dsh-liangshen 预设）为守卫式消息筛选，不注入指令。
summary.en: AI metadata review found no tool description poisoning or instruction injection. SKILL.md/AGENTS.md are developer collaboration files, not content injected into user LLM sessions. System prompt fragment registrations are legitimate plugin functions. The pre-step message filter (dsh-liangshen preset) is a guard-style message filter, does not inject instructions.

summary.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（l4-sandbox.json 不存在）。
summary.en: No dynamic sandbox verification performed (l4-sandbox.json does not exist).

limits.zh: 审计范围为仓库根（monorepo），包含 apps/dsh-desktop（Electron 桌面宿主）、apps/dsh-telemetry-worker（Cloudflare Worker，未逐文件核查——服务器端应用，非插件运行时内联外发）、packages/ 下多个 dsh 插件包与皮肤包、gallery/ 静态画廊、docs/ 文档等。插件包按 dsh 插件标准审计，桌面宿主代码按宿主代码审计。三个文件因超单文件帽未逐字通读：gallery/bundles.js（皮肤 bundle 预览）、gallery/official-facade.js（CSS/字体）、pnpm-lock.yaml（依赖锁文件）。大量皮肤资产（base64 图片、source map）的启发式扫描命中因读预算用尽无法逐条回读确认，但已读部分全部为皮肤图片/CSS 字符串/source map，非关键安全风险。动态沙箱（DG-L4）未启用。runtime-controller.mjs 等关键文件因读预算用尽仅读到开头部分，其子进程调用已从静态扫描命中确认在桌面宿主合法场景范围内。
limits.en: The audit scope is the repository root (monorepo), including apps/dsh-desktop (Electron desktop host), apps/dsh-telemetry-worker (Cloudflare Worker, not file-by-file verified — server-side application, not inline exfiltration within plugin runtime), multiple dsh plugin packages and skin packages under packages/, the static gallery/ directory, docs/, etc. Plugin packages are audited against dsh plugin standards, desktop host code is audited as host code. Three files were not read word-for-word due to file size cap: gallery/bundles.js (skin bundle preview), gallery/official-facade.js (CSS/fonts), pnpm-lock.yaml (dependency lock file). Heuristic scan hits on a large number of skin assets (base64 images, source maps) could not be individually confirmed due to read budget exhaustion, but all read portions are skin images/CSS strings/source maps, not critical security risks. Dynamic sandbox (DG-L4) not enabled. Key files such as runtime-controller.mjs were only partially read due to read budget exhaustion, but the subprocess calls confirmed from static scan hits fall within the scope of legitimate desktop host scenarios.
